title: Miscellaneous Laws

questions.question: If you see your brother’s ox or sheep going astray, what should you do?
options: Bring it back to your brother
questions.correctAnswer: Bring it back to your brother
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:1 (ESV): "You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep going astray and ignore them. You shall take them back to your brother."

questions.question: If you find a bird's nest, what can you take?
options: The young, but let the mother go
questions.correctAnswer: The young, but let the mother go
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:6–7 (ESV): "you shall not take the mother with the young. You shall let the mother go, but the young you may take..."

questions.question: What must you build when you build a new house?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:8 (ESV): "When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof..."

questions.question: Why build the parapet?
options: That you may not bring the guilt of blood upon your house if anyone falls
questions.correctAnswer: That you may not bring the guilt of blood upon your house if anyone falls
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:8 (ESV): "that you may not bring the guilt of blood upon your house, if anyone should fall from it."

questions.question: What clothing rule distinguishes men and women?
options: A woman shall not wear a man's garment, nor a man a woman's cloak
Men wear red, women wear blue
questions.correctAnswer: A woman shall not wear a man's garment, nor a man a woman's cloak
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:5 (ESV): "A woman shall not wear a man's garment, nor shall a man put on a woman's cloak..."

questions.question: What is forbidden regarding plowing?
options: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:10 (ESV): "You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together."

questions.question: What mixture is forbidden in cloth?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:11 (ESV): "You shall not wear cloth of wool and linen mixed together."

questions.question: Where should tassels be made?
options: On the four corners of the garment
questions.correctAnswer: On the four corners of the garment
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:12 (ESV): "You shall make yourself tassels on the four corners of the garment with which you cover yourself."

questions.question: If a man falsely accuses his wife of not being a virgin, what is the penalty?
options: He is whipped and fined 100 shekels
questions.correctAnswer: He is whipped and fined 100 shekels
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:18–19 (ESV): "then the elders of that city shall take the man and whip him, and they shall fine him a hundred shekels..."

questions.question: If the accusation is true (no evidence of virginity found), what happens?
options: She is stoned to death at her father's door
questions.correctAnswer: She is stoned to death at her father's door
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:21 (ESV): "then they shall bring out the young woman... and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones..."

questions.question: If a man lies with a betrothed virgin in the city and she does not cry out, who is punished?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:23–24 (ESV): "you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death..."

questions.question: Why is the woman punished in the city case?
options: Because she did not cry for help though she was in the city
questions.correctAnswer: Because she did not cry for help though she was in the city
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:24 (ESV): "the young woman because she did not cry for help though she was in the city..."

questions.question: If the man forces a betrothed virgin in the field, who is punished?
options: Only the man who lay with her
questions.correctAnswer: Only the man who lay with her
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:25–26 (ESV): "...then only the man who lay with her shall die. But you shall do nothing to the young woman..."

questions.question: Why is the woman in the field not punished?
options: For she cried out, but there was no one to save her
questions.correctAnswer: For she cried out, but there was no one to save her
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:27 (ESV): "For he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried for help, but there was no one to save her."

questions.question: If a man seizes a virgin who is not betrothed and lies with her, what must he do?
options: Pay the father 50 shekels and she shall be his wife; he may not divorce her
questions.correctAnswer: Pay the father 50 shekels and she shall be his wife; he may not divorce her
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:28–29 (ESV): "then the man... shall give to the father... fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife... he may not put her away all his days."

key_verse_text: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way and ignore them. You shall help him to lift them up again. (ESV)
